Name: Just Buy Buildings
Author: Lehasan
Description:
[size=2][center][b][/b][/center][/size][left][/left][left][size=3]﻿﻿﻿﻿[/size][b][size=4]Just Buy Buildings[/size][/b][size=3] - Allows you to buy farm buildings from Robin and the Wizard for money only - no trees, stones, or other materials required.[/size]

[b][size=4]How the mod works[/size][/b][/left][size=3]Instead of simply removing the need for resources, this mod converts the total resource amount for construction into gold, multiplies it by a 1.5 coefficient, and adds it to the building’s base price.[/size]

[size=3]In other words, the final building price is calculated using the formula:
[color=#ffff00](building base price + resource cost) × 1.5[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
[size=3]If you want to increase or decrease construction prices, you can edit the [b]config.json[/b] file located in the mod folder.
Change the following option:[/size]

[code]﻿{
  "PriceMultiplier": 1.5
}
[/code]
[size=3]The higher the [b]PriceMultiplier [/b]value, the higher the construction prices, and vice versa.[/size]

[size=3]If you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] installed, you can change [b]PriceMultiplier [/b]directly in the game; GMCM is optional.[/size]

[b][size=5]﻿INSTALL[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (optional)[/size]

[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][b][size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b][size=4][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][/size][size=3]﻿Compatible with other mods that add buildings sold by Robin and the Wizard; it removes resource requirements and adjusts prices in those mods as well.[/size]
